lines.1: Time to hurry up and brush my teeth--
lines.5: I genuinely grabbed the wrong one.
lines.6: 「Mistaking an 'Otome's' toothbrush for your own and using it... You will make her hate you.」
lines.7: 「Want me to buy you a new one at the convenience store?」
lines.8: 「It will be usable after sterilizing it in boiling water.」
lines.10: 「I only say that because you and I go so far back.」
lines.11: 「But if you want my honest feelings...」
lines.17: 「No. Considering the rough seas society will put you through, I should be strict with you here.」
lines.18: 「If you keep working hard, I will be gentle.」
lines.19: And with that, another day comes to a safe end.
lines.20: Things were surprisingly fulfilling after school today.
lines.21: Apparently boiling it changed the toothbrush's shape.
